subject: FIND-STRING function
notes: §15.37.2's three optional elements give 12 written shapes ([LAST] x argument-3 absent/bare/START-AFTER x [ANYCASE]); the golden writes all 12 with §15.37.4-derived values, four of which - including the maximal LAST+START AFTER+ANYCASE - had no case. Every needle has matches exactly len(argument-2) apart, so no value depends on the under-determined overlapping-occurrence reading. Order and multiplicity rejected by conformance:cases/_unassigned/find-string-anycase-before-last and conformance:cases/_unassigned/find-string-four-operands.
